query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.avgCost as currentCost,
  (
    SELECT SUM(pc.quantity * p2.avgCost)
    FROM productCompositions pc
    JOIN products p2 ON pc.childProductId = p2.id
    WHERE pc.parentProductId = p.id
  ) as calculatedCost
FROM products p
WHERE p.isComposite = 1 AND p.id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT parentProductId FROM productCompositions
)
